desc:
🎓 Welcome to Streamer University! 🎓

A chaotic, action-packed fighting game set in a wild school inspired by your favorite streamer vibes. Whether you’re here to squad up, chill, or throw hands, Streamer University brings non-stop hype and drama to the hallways.

🤝 Link up with friends, start rivalries, and rise through the social ranks in epic 1v1 showdowns, crew battles, or all-out cafeteria brawls!

Who will be the Number 1 Streamer?

🎮 Basic Controls:
PC:

🖱️ Left Mouse – Attack
🫳 G – Grab
👟 F – Stomp
🌟 R - Special Ability
🔀 W A S D – Move
🎯 W A S D + Space – Weave/Dodge

Console:

🔨 RT/R2 – Attack
🤜 B/Circle – Grab
👞 X/Square – Stomp
🔄 Left Analog + LT/L2 – Weave/Dodge
🌟 Triangle/Y – Special Ability

⭐️ Like and favorite Fight in a Streamer University to support us and unlock more awesome updates! Your love keeps the fun alive! 🎮💖
